name: DENC8LOINCConceptMap
title: DEN.C8 ConceptMap to LOINC
description: Candidate mappings from DEN.C8 local concepts to LOINC, transcribed from the source data dictionary without asserting validated equivalence.

text.div: Workbook candidates are transcribed without asserting exact equivalence. All candidate relations use relatedto and require terminology review; blank and not-classifiable cells have no target. LOINC codes on test-order choices and the source serology description/code mismatch are specifically flagged for review.
